title: Merkle-batched release signing: one C10 ceremony per release covering every (board, secure, NS) artifact, with a bounded per-image proof in the unsigned manifest region
threat: Each additional signed artifact (now two boards, later revisions, plus a future PQDESC_V1 descriptor root) consumes one signature of the vendor key's finite C10 budget (OPEN-C10-1) and one HSM ceremony; today's format signs one 75/121-byte preimage per image, so the signature count scales with the artifact count and the insider/ceremony surface grows with it.
proposal: In the V6 amendment (with FWU-3): the signed value becomes a Merkle root over leaves `SHA-256(0x00 || preimage_i)` with order-independent internal nodes `SHA-256(0x01 || min || max)`; each manifest carries its own leaf preimage plus a proof path (<= 8 nodes, 32 B each) in the unsigned region; the device recomputes the root and verifies ONE C10 signature. fwsign gains a `sign-release-set` that builds the tree over all artifacts of a release set (both boards, optional descriptor-root leaf) and emits per-artifact manifests. Bound the proof length and check it fits inside the manifest page before any pointer is formed.
rationale: Trezor moved its PQ bootloader signing to exactly this structure so one slow SLH-DSA ceremony covers all models/revisions/builds, with proof size independent of batch size — directly relevant to pq1 where C10 signing is expensive, the key budget is capped, and the release set just doubled with the second board. It also gives the OPEN-REL-1 'release-set authority' a cryptographic object (the root) rather than a convention.

risks: V6 schema change (owner-gated, see FWU-3). The FSBL must parse a proof path — new bounds-checked parser in the frozen stage (fuzz + Kani before freeze; BitBox's AI-found bootloader flaw is the warning). Order-independent node hashing must be modelled in the ProVerif fw_update_authenticity.pv (domain separation of 0x00/0x01 prefixes vs PQFW tags). DROPPED: per-chunk pre-write hash authentication (usb-fw-update-hardening.md:329 judged no security gain over whole-image COMMIT re-hash); fix_version soft floor with forced SE wipe on security-relevant downgrade (overlaps the 2026-07-26 errata's declined availability paths); first-boot 0xFF image padding + published page-mutation map for the SWD verify story (Trezor combine.rs — not verified against pq1's release packaging in this pass); FSBL pre-jump SRAM/peripheral reset (only public data in FSBL SRAM today); signed-flag prodtest image class + OTP line-complete latch (Trezor ALLOW_PROVISIONING); companion GetFirmwareHash (explicitly NOT recommended — known-bypassable); OptRand anti-klepto and measurement-bound key wrap (both on the do-not-resurface list in vendor-signing-key-compromise.md:457-466,666-676).
